tagline: Track books on your shelves and who has them.
summary: A single list of books with fields for title, author, and category. Lend a book by setting a borrower; clear the borrower when it comes back. Filter to see what is out and how many are lent.

stats.label: Lent out
stats.rule: count of rows where Borrower is not empty

journeys.title: add a book and see it in the list
journeys.steps: Open the app; the list is empty. Click Add. Enter Title, Author, choose Category. Save.
journeys.expect: The book appears in the list. The Lent out stat shows 0.

journeys.title: reject an empty required field
journeys.steps: Click Add. Leave Title empty. Enter Author, choose Category. Save.
journeys.expect: The form shows 'Title is required' and does not save.

journeys.title: edit an existing book
journeys.steps: Pick a book in the list. Click Edit. Change Title. Save.
journeys.expect: The list shows the updated Title.

journeys.title: delete a book added by mistake
journeys.steps: Pick a book in the list. Click Delete. Confirm.
journeys.expect: The book is removed from the list.

journeys.title: lend a book and show the borrower
journeys.steps: Pick a book with no Borrower. Click Lend. Enter a name. Save.
journeys.expect: The book shows the badge 'Lent to {Borrower}'. The Lent out stat increases by 1.

journeys.title: return a book and clear the borrower
journeys.steps: Pick a book that is lent out. Click Return.
journeys.expect: The 'Lent to {Borrower}' badge disappears. The Lent out stat decreases by 1.

journeys.title: filter to see only books that are lent out
journeys.steps: With some books lent out, click the 'Lent out' filter.
journeys.expect: The list shows only books where Borrower is not empty. Each shows the 'Lent to {Borrower}' badge.

journeys.title: filter to see only books that are at home
journeys.expect: The list shows only books where Borrower is empty. No 'Lent to' badges appear.

journeys.title: see how many books are lent out right now
journeys.expect: The 'Lent out' stat shows the count of rows where Borrower is not empty.

journeys.title: persist data across a browser refresh
journeys.steps: Add or lend several books. Refresh the browser.
journeys.expect: All books, borrowers, and the Lent out stat are unchanged.

omitted_patterns.reason: The idea does not mention when books are due back.

omitted_patterns.pattern: multiple copies or quantities per title
omitted_patterns.reason: The idea treats each book as a single item.
The idea states it is just one person on their own computer.
The idea asks for a list and a lent-out filter but not text search.
The idea does not mention where a book sits or what it looks like.

assumptions: The category select uses the three kinds the user named: Novel, Cookbook, Reference.
A book with no Borrower is considered at home; a book with a Borrower is lent out.
The headline stat is the count of books currently lent out.
